size_semantics: circle diameter; other shapes use canonical target_at side; record actual support bounding box and area
order: interleave shapes and sizes; repeat a fixed reference between groups
probe_split: calibration directions, independent unseen directions, and final shape replay are separate
exposure_policy: adapt between blocks; fixed within reference/candidate block; repeat final phase at multiple unsaturated exposures
qualification: Coverage of sampled conditions, not a guarantee for arbitrary optical paths; phase gradients and exposure must be part of the validity range
